## Do not edit these files here

They are **generated**. The source of wording lives in the app repository under
`catCam-docs/`, and `scripts/build_legal_pages.mjs` renders it into this repo and
into the copy bundled inside the app. Editing a page here will be overwritten on the
next build, and would put the hosted wording out of sync with what ships in the app.
